en: You have arrived at an excellent time, Parker. Feeding time!
zh: 你来得正是时候，帕克，喂食时间到了！

en: Not to worry, Parker. Those specimens were a failed batch anyway.
zh: 别担心，帕克，那些标本反正也是失败品。

en: I have plenty of scientists to assist me, Parker. A few less matter not at all.
zh: 我有很多科学家协助我，帕克，少几个根本无关紧要。

en: Look closely, Parker. Do you recognize any old friends?
zh: 仔细看看，帕克，你认得出什么老朋友吗？

en: Not every specimen reacts favorably to nanotech injections.
zh: 不是每个标本都能对纳米技术注射产生良好反应。

en: But, no matter, even the failures teach us something.
zh: 不过无妨，即便是失败品也能教会我们一些东西。

en: In the advancement of science, anyone, even you, Parker, can serve a useful purpose.
zh: 为了科学的进步，任何人，甚至是你，帕克，都能发挥有用的作用。

en: I must be going now, Parker. Enjoy your stay among my exhibits.
zh: 我现在必须离开了，帕克，好好享受我这些展品的陪伴吧。

en: Maybe you will have the honor of joining them someday soon.
zh: 也许不久之后，你就有幸成为它们的一员了。

en: Perhaps we will meet again, Parker. You should hope not.
zh: 也许我们还会再见，帕克，你最好祈祷不会。

en: Ah, I see you have reached my submarine bay. Go ahead, Parker. Take a ride.
zh: 啊，看来你已经抵达我的潜艇舱了。去吧，帕克，搭一程吧。

en: Parker! I did it! I cracked into the security network for Capek's secret labs.
zh: 帕克！我成功了！我侵入了卡佩克秘密实验室的安保网络。

en: That's where he's heading, Parker. There's a huge research facility down there.
zh: 他正往那里去，帕克。下面有一座巨大的研究设施。

en: I contacted Eos. She's headed that way too.
zh: 我联系了伊欧丝，她也正在往那边赶。

en: I can't reach Eos. I left a message with Orion, in case she checks in.
zh: 我联系不上伊欧丝。我给奥莱恩留了消息，以防她报平安。

en: This is the feeding chute, Parker. Something is hungry.
zh: 这是喂食槽，帕克，有东西饿了。

en: You won't believe the things that've been going on in this lab, Parker.
zh: 你不会相信这间实验室里发生过什么，帕克。

en: This is the source of the Plague, that's for sure.
zh: 这里肯定就是瘟疫的源头。

en: Capek's been working on nanotechnology, testing its effects on living beings.
zh: 卡佩克一直在研究纳米技术，测试它对生物的影响。

en: Animals or humans -- Capek doesn't care. The Plague is his creation. Be very careful, Parker.
zh: 动物还是人类 —— 卡佩克根本不在乎，瘟疫就是他创造的。务必小心，帕克。

en: Come, Parker. I am waiting for you.
zh: 来吧，帕克，我在等你。

en: No, Parker, I will not make it that easy.
zh: 不，帕克，我不会让事情变得那么简单。

en: Keep pressing the button, Parker. Perhaps it will suddenly work.
zh: 继续按按钮吧，帕克，也许它突然就会起作用。

en: I weary of this, Parker. Perhaps you should find another way.
zh: 我厌倦了这个，帕克，也许你该另找一条路。

en: You sure he's coming?
zh: 你确定他会来？

en: Just keep your eyes open. You don't wanna be the guy who let someone into Capek's labs. Wouldn't be healthy.
zh: 只管瞪大眼睛，你可不想当那个放人进卡佩克实验室的家伙，那可没有好下场。

en: Why bother? No one's gonna come this way.
zh: 何必呢？没人会从这边来。

en: I dunno. Somethin's spooked Capek, the way he flew through the main gate.
zh: 不知道。卡佩克好像被什么吓到了，看他飞快穿过大门的样子。

en: Welcome to my domain, Parker.
zh: 欢迎来到我的领域，帕克。

en: I trust you will find it to your liking....
zh: 我相信你会喜欢这里的……

en: You will pay for every iota of damage you cause, Parker. You will pay dearly.
zh: 你造成的每一点损害都要付出代价，帕克，你会付出惨痛的代价。

en: Please don't hurt me. I just work here.
zh: 请别伤害我，我只是这里的员工。

en: Don't go in there. He's waiting for you.
zh: 别进去，他在等你。

en: But it's cold and I'm tired. There's no one coming.
zh: 可是这里很冷，我也累了，不会有人来的。

en: Just shut up and keep your eyes open. You're gonna get us both killed.
zh: 闭嘴，瞪大眼睛就行，你会害死我们两个的。

en: Step inside, Parker. Some of my most promising specimens reside within.
zh: 进来吧，帕克。我最有前途的一些标本就在里面。

en: Perhaps you would like a closer look?
zh: 也许你想靠近点看看？

en: [cut] I have arranged some entertainment for you, Parker. Watch.
zh: [cut] 我为你安排了一些娱乐节目，帕克。看吧。

en: Who knows, Parker? These might have once been friends of yours.
zh: 谁知道呢，帕克？这些也许曾经是你的朋友。

en: So hard to tell now, is it not?
zh: 现在很难分辨了，不是吗？

en: Ah, I see I have another uninvited guest. I need to make arrangements for her as well.
zh: 啊，看来我又有一位不速之客。我也得为她做些安排。

en: Don't shoot me. Capek told us you were coming.
zh: 别开枪。卡佩克告诉我们你会来。

en: He's in the central research chamber. He's the one you want.
zh: 他在中央研究室。你要找的就是他。

en: You'll never get through his nanotech shield, though. Get away, while you still can!
zh: 不过你永远突破不了他的纳米护盾。趁还能走，快逃吧！

en: Run! Now! Or you'll end up like those, those...things.
zh: 快跑！现在！不然你就会变得跟那些、那些……东西一样。

en: Get out of here, you fool! Don't you see what happens to miners Capek gets his hands on?
zh: 滚出这里，你这个蠢货！你没看到落到卡佩克手里的矿工会变成什么样吗？

en: You are entering my inner sanctum now, Parker. Enjoy your last few minutes of normal life.
zh: 你现在正进入我的内殿，帕克，享受你正常人生的最后几分钟吧。

en: Ah, together again, Parker. This time, I shall not be so merciful.
zh: 啊，又相聚了，帕克。这一次，我不会再那么仁慈了。

en: And Eos here as well. Let us invite your friend Hendrix to join us, shall we?
zh: 伊欧丝也在这里，让我们也邀请你的朋友亨德里克斯加入吧，如何？

en: Alas, my dear, you have no say in who lives or dies here.
zh: 可惜，亲爱的，在这里谁生谁死，不由你决定。

en: Fools! You cannot begin to understand the forces I control!
zh: 蠢货！你们根本无法理解我所掌控的力量！

en: No! You will die for that, Parker!
zh: 不！你会为此而死，帕克！

en: Capek! Give us the antidote for the Plague and we'll let you live!
zh: 卡佩克！把瘟疫解药交出来，我们就放你一条生路！

en: Good idea, Parker! I'll keep him busy. You go after his power source!
zh: 好主意，帕克！我来拖住他，你去找他的能量源！

en: Parker, go out the way I came in. Someone's waiting outside for you.
zh: 帕克，从我进来的路出去，外面有人在等你。

en: There's something you need to do for me. He'll explain; I don't have the time!
zh: 我需要你帮我做件事，他会跟你解释的，我没时间了！

en: You're wasting my time and yours. Just go!
zh: 你在浪费我的时间，也在浪费你自己的时间，快走！

en: Don't be a fool. If you don't go, we'll both die here!
zh: 别犯傻，你不走，我们两个都会死在这里！

en: There's no time now. Run!
zh: 没时间了，快跑！

en: Self-destruct sequence initiated. Personnel have 75 seconds to evacuate.
zh: 自毁程序已启动，人员有75秒时间撤离。

en: Self-destruct sequence initiated. Personnel have 60 seconds to evacuate.
zh: 自毁程序已启动，人员有60秒时间撤离。

en: Self-destruct sequence initiated. Personnel have 45 seconds to evacuate.
zh: 自毁程序已启动，人员有45秒时间撤离。

en: Self-destruct sequence initiated. Personnel have 30 seconds to evacuate.
zh: 自毁程序已启动，人员有30秒时间撤离。

en: Self-destruct sequence initiated. Personnel have 15 seconds to evacuate.
zh: 自毁程序已启动，人员有15秒时间撤离。

en: 60 seconds to self-destruct.
zh: 距离自毁还有60秒。

en: 45 seconds to self-destruct.
zh: 距离自毁还有45秒。

en: 30 seconds to self-destruct.
zh: 距离自毁还有30秒。

en: 15 seconds to self-destruct.
zh: 距离自毁还有15秒。

en: 10 seconds to self-destruct.
zh: 距离自毁还有10秒。

en: Parker, Orion says Eos was planning to bring a computer disk to Ultor's Communications Center.
zh: 帕克，奥莱恩说伊欧丝原本计划把一张电脑磁盘带到乌尔托通讯中心。

en: Eos had contacts in the Earth Defense Force. She thought they'd send a rescue fleet if we put out a distress call.
zh: 伊欧丝在地球防卫军里有联系人。她认为只要我们发出求救信号，他们就会派救援舰队来。

en: The message and transmission codes are on the disk. All you have to do is get it to a communications console.
zh: 消息和传输代码都在磁盘上，你只要把它带到通讯控制台就行。

en: The Comm Center's at the end of this canyon. Let's deal with the canyon first, then look for a way up to the Comm Center.
zh: 通讯中心就在这条峡谷尽头。先处理峡谷这边，再想办法上到通讯中心。

en: Somewhere down there is a natural tunnel that Ultor used as an outflow pipe for the sewage system.
zh: 下面某处有一条天然隧道，乌尔托曾把它用作污水系统的排流管。

en: That's the only way up from the canyon floor.
zh: 那是从峡谷底部上去的唯一通道。

en: It was blocked by a landslide about six months ago, but Ultor cleared it off.
zh: 大约六个月前，它被山体滑坡堵住了，不过乌尔托后来清理掉了。

en: Are you Parker? Eos said that if she didn't come out, you would.
zh: 你是帕克吗？伊欧丝说过，如果她没出来，你就会过来。

en: She said to give you this computer disk. I dunno why.
zh: 她让我把这张电脑磁盘交给你，我也不知道为什么。

en: We need to go to the far end of the canyon.
zh: 我们得去峡谷另一头。

en: I'll drive. You hop in back and man the gun.
zh: 我来开车，你跳到后面去操纵机枪。

en: It was rough getting here, and I don't expect it'll be any easier getting back.
zh: 来的路就很难走，我看回去也轻松不了。

en: Keep them off us or we'll never make it through!
zh: 把他们挡住，不然我们根本过不去！

en: Still no word from Eos. I don't think she made it.
zh: 还是没有伊欧丝的消息，我觉得她没能活下来。

en: First Eos is lost, and now Ultor's sent in reinforcements.
zh: 先是伊欧丝失踪，现在乌尔托又派来了增援。

en: They've kept a regiment of mercenaries in reserve. Now they're coming out.
zh: 他们一直留着一支雇佣兵团作为预备队，现在他们出来了。

en: The mercs are led by Colonel Masako, a real nasty piece of work.
zh: 雇佣兵由雅子上校率领，是个真正狠毒的货色。

en: They're all butchers, and she's the worst of them.
zh: 他们全是屠夫，而她是最糟的那个。

en: Got some more bad news for you, Parker.
zh: 还有更多坏消息要告诉你，帕克。

en: Orion still hasn't heard from Eos, but that's not the really bad news.
zh: 奥莱恩还是没有收到伊欧丝的消息，但那还不是最坏的消息。

en: Once you've sent the message from the Comm Center, we still have to get the fleet in here.
zh: 你从通讯中心发出信息之后，我们还得把舰队引进来。

en: Ultor has a system of laser satellites orbiting Mars. They'll tear the fleet apart unless we disable them somehow.
zh: 乌尔托有一套环绕火星运行的激光卫星系统。除非我们设法关闭它，否则舰队会被撕成碎片。

en: There's a space station that controls the satellites. We've got to get you up there.
zh: 有一座空间站控制着这些卫星，我们必须把你送上去。

en: But let's get that message out first.
zh: 不过先把那条消息发出去。

en: I don't know how much longer I can deal with this crap.
zh: 我不知道我还能忍受这种破事多久。

en: Hey, I'd rather be down here where it's quiet than up top where all hell's breaking loose.
zh: 嘿，我宁愿待在下面这个安静的地方，也不想上去面对乱成一团的地面。

en: I guess, but it really stinks down here.
zh: 我想也是，不过下面真的臭死了。

en: In a couple more months, you won't even notice.
zh: 再过几个月，你甚至都不会注意到了。

en: That's what I'm afraid of.
zh: 这正是我害怕的。

en: Hey, I've been down here for years, and it hasn't affected me none.
zh: 嘿，我在下面待了好几年了，这对我一点影响都没有。

en: I notice you don't get invited to a lot of parties....
zh: 我注意到你没怎么被邀请去参加派对……

en: Yeah, yeah. Get back to work, wiseass.
zh: 是是是。回去干活吧，臭嘴。

en: You're in, Parker. Now for the hard part.
zh: 你进来了，帕克，接下来才是难的部分。

en: The console you need to reach is at the highest level of the Comm Center.
zh: 你要到达的控制台在通讯中心的最高层。

en: Code Yellow Alert. Intruder in Communications Center. Apprehend or neutralize immediately.
zh: 黄色代码警报。通讯中心有入侵者，立即逮捕或击毙。

en: Did you hear gunfire? Something's going on.
zh: 你听到枪声了吗？出事了。

en: Just stay here and do your job. Let the guards and mercs handle it. That's their job.
zh: 待在这里干你的活，让警卫和雇佣兵去处理，那是他们的工作。

en: Parker! There are mercenaries in the Communications Center!
zh: 帕克！通讯中心里有雇佣兵！

en: They're starting to appear all over the complex, taking over from the security guards.
zh: 他们开始出现在设施各处，接替安保警卫。

en: They're killing every miner and guard they see.
zh: 他们见到矿工和警卫就杀。

en: If you're going to do this, do it now!
zh: 你要是真打算做，那就趁现在！

en: That's the way out, but it's locked. I'm working on it.
zh: 那是出口，但锁上了，我正在处理。

en: Keep moving! You've got to reach the top level.
zh: 继续前进！你必须到达顶层。

en: The console you want is under the windows that look out onto the transmission dish.
zh: 你要找的控制台在那些能看到传输天线的窗户下方。

en: The airlock at the tower's base is open now. I hacked into the security system and overrode its locks.
zh: 塔底的气闸现在打开了，我侵入了安保系统并覆盖了它的锁定。

en: Code Red Alert. Intruder in Communications Tower.
zh: 红色代码警报，通讯塔有入侵者。

en: Remember the miners on the shuttle that got blown up?
zh: 还记得那艘被炸毁的航天飞机上的矿工吗？

en: To get you to the space station safely, we need to take out Ultor's missile defense system.
zh: 为了把你安全送上空间站，我们需要摧毁乌尔托的导弹防御系统。

en: The tram tunnels go to Missile Command. There's an entrance to the tunnels through this canyon.
zh: 电车隧道通往导弹指挥部。穿过这条峡谷可以进入隧道。

en: The mercs have fortified this area. Keep moving and keep your head down!
zh: 雇佣兵已经加固了这片区域。继续前进，低头隐蔽！

en: This tram should take you to the Missile Command Center.
zh: 这辆电车应该能把你送到导弹指挥中心。

en: Once you've disabled the missile systems, we can get you onto the next shuttle up to the space station.
zh: 等你关闭导弹系统，我们就能把你送上下一班前往空间站的航天飞机。

en: If those missiles are still active, Ultor will shoot the shuttle out of the sky.
zh: 如果那些导弹仍然处于激活状态，乌尔托会把航天飞机从天上打下来。

en: Don't get off here! This isn't the Missile Command Center.
zh: 别在这里下车！这里不是导弹指挥中心。

en: Get back on the tram! If it leaves without you, you'll never reach the shuttle in time!
zh: 回到电车上！如果它丢下你开走，你就赶不上航天飞机了！

en: Parker, Eos here.
zh: 帕克，我是伊欧丝。

en: I found the antidote formula and got out of there. Glad to see you made it too.
zh: 我找到了那份解药配方，并且逃出来了。很高兴看到你也活下来了。

en: We've got people synthesizing the antidote now. Then we'll see if it works.
zh: 我们已经有人在合成解药了，然后就看它有没有用了。

en: But you've gotta get up to that space station and disable the laser satellite network.
zh: 但你必须登上那座空间站，关闭激光卫星网络。

en: If that defense system is still working when the EDF fleet shows up, they'll get blown out of the sky.
zh: 如果EDF舰队抵达时那套防御系统还在运作，他们会被从天上炸下来。

en: Code Yellow Alert. Intruder in tramway system. Security response level 2.
zh: 黄色代码警报，电车系统有入侵者，安保响应等级2。

en: The Command Center's at the back of this building. Hurry!
zh: 指挥中心就在这栋建筑后方，快！

en: I've jammed the missile bay doors closed. All you have to do is send the launch signal.
zh: 我已经把导弹发射井舱门卡死了，你只需要发送发射信号。

en: The missiles will explode in their launch bays and destroy that part of the complex.
zh: 导弹会在发射井内爆炸，并摧毁设施的那一部分。

en: Run, Parker! Get to the tram and get out of there!
zh: 跑，帕克！赶到电车那里，离开这里！

en: That whole area's gonna blow!
zh: 整片区域都要炸了！

en: Code Red Alert. Intruder in Missile Command Center. Security response level 1.
zh: 红色代码警报，导弹指挥中心有入侵者，安保响应等级1。

en: Unauthorized missile launch sequence in progress. Abort immediately.
zh: 未经授权的导弹发射程序正在进行，立即中止。

en: 30 seconds until missile launch.
zh: 距离导弹发射还有30秒。

en: 20 seconds until missile launch.
zh: 距离导弹发射还有20秒。

en: 10 seconds until missile launch.
zh: 距离导弹发射还有10秒。

en: Missile launch aborted.
zh: 导弹发射已中止。

en: Out of my way, you fool! I have to stop that launch or we'll all die!
zh: 让开，你这个蠢货！我必须阻止发射，不然我们都会死！

en: Parker, are you still there? Stop standing around and get going!
zh: 帕克，你还在吗？别站着发呆，快走！

en: I'm putting a countdown timer for the shuttle liftoff on your HUD.
zh: 我会把航天飞机起飞倒计时放到你的HUD上。

en: That's how much time you have to reach it. You can still make it, if you hurry.
zh: 那就是你赶到那里还剩的时间。只要快点，你还来得及。

en: This looks like some kind of motor pool. Check around -- a vehicle would get you to the shuttle a lot faster.
zh: 这里看起来像是某种车库，四处找找，有辆车的话，你去航天飞机那边会快得多。

en: The mercs are coming out hard. My squads are pinned down all over the complex.
zh: 雇佣兵攻势很猛，我的小队在整个设施里都被压制住了。

en: Most of the miners outside our base are dead or hiding.
zh: 我们基地外的大多数矿工不是死了，就是躲起来了。

en: Don't stop for anything, Parker. You don't have much time left.
zh: 不要为任何事停下，帕克，你剩下的时间不多了。

en: The merc commander, Masako, is sending out a heavy weapons squad to stop you.
zh: 雇佣兵指挥官雅子正在派出一支重武器小队来阻止你。

en: Parker, please hurry. Our outlying guard posts are reporting skirmishes with merc squads.
zh: 帕克，请快点，我们的外围哨所报告说正与雇佣兵小队交火。

en: If the EDF doesn't get here soon, there's going to be nothing left.
zh: 如果EDF还不快点到，这里就什么都剩不下了。

en: Hurry, Parker! They're starting to seal up the shuttle bay.
zh: 快点，帕克！他们开始封锁航天飞机舱了。

en: That door's been sealed for launch. Look for another way in.
zh: 那扇门已经为发射封闭了，找别的路进去。

en: This is the cargo loading system.
zh: 这是货物装载系统。

en: You might be able to sneak in through the loading docks.
zh: 你也许能从装货码头偷偷进去。

en: Hurry, they're sealing the doors into the loading dock!
zh: 快，他们正在封闭通往装货码头的门！

en: Move it! The shuttle's sealing up!
zh: 快动！航天飞机正在封闭！

en: Shuttle liftoff in one minute.
zh: 航天飞机还有一分钟起飞。

en: Shuttle liftoff in 30 seconds.
zh: 航天飞机还有30秒起飞。

en: Parker -- find a place to hide before the shuttle takes off. Hurry!
zh: 帕克 —— 在航天飞机起飞前找个地方躲起来，快！

en: Shuttle liftoff in 5...4...3...2...1...Liftoff.
Shuttle liftoff in 15 seconds.
zh: 航天飞机还有15秒起飞。

en: You've gotta disable Ultor's planetary defense system before the fleet reaches Mars, or they'll be toast.
zh: 你必须在舰队抵达火星前关闭乌尔托的行星防御系统，否则他们就完了。

en: Parker, the mercs are all over the mining complex now.
zh: 帕克，现在雇佣兵已经遍布整个采矿设施。

en: Intruder alert. Sector lockdowns in effect. Code Red Emergency.
zh: 入侵者警报，区域封锁生效，红色代码紧急状态。

en: Reactor overload in 90 seconds.
zh: 反应堆90秒后过载。

en: Reactor overload in 60 seconds.
zh: 反应堆60秒后过载。

en: Reactor overload in 45 seconds.
zh: 反应堆45秒后过载。

en: Reactor overload in 30 seconds.
zh: 反应堆30秒后过载。

en: Reactor overload in 20 seconds.
zh: 反应堆20秒后过载。

en: Reactor overload in 15 seconds.
zh: 反应堆15秒后过载。

en: Reactor overload in 10 seconds...8...7...6...5...4...3...2...1...Overload.
You're in the reactor section now, Parker.
zh: 你现在在反应堆区了，帕克。

en: The command center is up this shaft. The escape pods and labs are down the shaft.
zh: 指挥中心在这条竖井上方，逃生舱和实验室在竖井下方。

en: You have to open this from the command center.
zh: 你必须从指挥中心打开这里。

en: That did it! The station's lower section should be open now.
zh: 成了！空间站下部区域现在应该打开了。

en: Parker, Ultor has received a message from the incoming EDF fleet.
zh: 帕克，乌尔托收到了来自正在接近的EDF舰队的一条消息。

en: It was encoded, so I don't know what it said, but they're panicking down here.
zh: 消息经过加密，所以我不知道内容，但他们在下面已经慌了。

en: They're destroying documents and computer systems. And the merc docking bays are swarming with activity.
zh: 他们正在销毁文件和电脑系统，雇佣兵停靠舱那边也忙成了一团。

en: Parker, are the defenses down yet? The mercs are in our base, coming from all directions!
zh: 帕克，关掉防御系统了吗？雇佣兵已经进了我们的基地，正从四面八方涌来！

en: Parker, Hendrix...base overrun...fighting retreat...falling apart....
zh: 帕克，亨德里克斯……基地被攻破……边打边撤……全线崩溃……

en: Look for overrides to open the station's doors.
zh: 寻找覆盖开关来打开空间站的门。

en: That should open up the lower section of the station.
zh: 那应该能打开空间站的下部区域。

en: The laser satellites are controlled from this room and the next one.
zh: 激光卫星由这个房间和隔壁房间控制。

en: Each computer controls part of the defensive grid. Take out all eight computers to disable the system.
zh: 每台电脑控制防御网的一部分，摧毁全部八台电脑即可关闭系统。

en: The defense system is down temporarily. The only way to permanently disable it is to destroy the station.
zh: 防御系统暂时关闭了。要永久关闭它，唯一的办法就是摧毁空间站。

en: Now overload the reactor and get out!
zh: 现在让反应堆过载，然后离开！

en: Reactor overload in 60 seconds.
zh: 反应堆60秒后过载。

en: Reactor overload in 45 seconds.
zh: 反应堆45秒后过载。

en: Reactor overload in 30 seconds.
zh: 反应堆30秒后过载。

en: Reactor overload in 20 seconds.
zh: 反应堆20秒后过载。

en: Reactor overload in 15 seconds.
zh: 反应堆15秒后过载。

en: Reactor overload in 10 seconds...8...7...6...5...4...3...2...1...Overload.
That's it, Parker. Now get out of there before the whole place blows!
zh: 就是这样，帕克。现在在整个地方爆炸前快走！

en: Great! Now overload the reactor and get out of there!
zh: 很好！现在让反应堆过载，然后离开那里！

en: Good, Parker. Now find the control room and shut down the satellite defenses.
zh: 很好，帕克。现在找到控制室，关闭卫星防御系统。

en: Parker, I've lost contact with the Red Faction base.
zh: 帕克，我和红色派系基地失去联系了。

en: I can't raise Eos, Orion, or anyone else there.
zh: 我联系不上伊欧丝、奥莱恩，或者那里的任何人。

en: There are miners scattered all over the complex. I'm trying to contact them and gather them together.
zh: 整个设施里散落着矿工，我正在尝试联系他们，把他们聚集起来。

en: Reactor overload in 60 seconds.
zh: 反应堆60秒后过载。

en: Reactor overload in 45 seconds.
zh: 反应堆45秒后过载。

en: Reactor overload in 30 seconds.
zh: 反应堆30秒后过载。

en: Reactor overload in 20 seconds.
zh: 反应堆20秒后过载。

en: Reactor overload in 15 seconds.
zh: 反应堆15秒后过载。

en: Reactor overload in 10 seconds...8...7...6...5...4...3...2...1...Overload.
Escape pod access denied unless reactor overload imminent.
zh: 除非反应堆即将过载，否则拒绝进入逃生舱。

en: Parker, you still alive? I've sent some miners to the crash site to find you.
zh: 帕克，你还活着吗？我派了一些矿工去坠毁地点找你。

en: They'll try to guide you to the merc base. We're in big trouble.
zh: 他们会试着引导你前往雇佣兵基地，我们遇上大麻烦了。

en: The mercs have orders to evacuate the base and destroy the entire mining complex.
zh: 雇佣兵接到命令，要撤离基地并摧毁整个采矿设施。

en: The mercs didn't have to go after the Red Faction base. That was Colonel Masako's idea -- payback for all the trouble the miners caused.
zh: 雇佣兵本来没必要攻击红色派系基地，那是雅子上校的主意 —— 为了报复矿工们给他们惹出的麻烦。

en: She led the assault. I overheard her radioing the merc base, reporting complete success.
zh: 是她率领了那次突袭。我偷听到她用无线电向雇佣兵基地报告，说行动完全成功。

en: The mercs have a bomb, Parker. Some kind of nuclear device. They're going to set it to blow after they've left.
zh: 雇佣兵有一枚炸弹，帕克，某种核装置。他们会在离开后设定它爆炸。

en: It's going to wipe out the entire complex, destroying all evidence of Ultor's experiments on Mars, and all of us.
zh: 它会抹掉整个设施，摧毁乌尔托在火星上进行实验的一切证据，也摧毁我们所有人。

en: I'm leading a group of miners to attack the merc base now. Might as well die there as here....
zh: 我现在正带着一群矿工去攻击雇佣兵基地，与其死在这里，不如死在那里……

en: At least Orion's still alive. I contacted him and he's leading a group to the merc base too.
zh: 至少奥莱恩还活着，我联系到了他，他也正带着一队人前往雇佣兵基地。

en: I'll see you there, if we both make it.
zh: 如果我们都能活下来，就在那里见。

en: Parker -- follow me! We've got an assault team waiting for us.
zh: 帕克 —— 跟我来！我们有一支突击队在等着。

en: Ambush!
zh: 埋伏！

en: We're pinned down!
zh: 我们被压制住了！

en: Almost there. Our assault team is just ahead.
zh: 快到了，我们的突击队就在前面。

en: Their snipers are wiping us out!
zh: 他们的狙击手正在把我们一个个干掉！

en: We'll try to hold here and cover you, Parker. You need to meet Hendrix inside the merc base. Good luck!
zh: 我们会试着守在这里掩护你，帕克，你需要在雇佣兵基地内和亨德里克斯会合。祝你好运！

en: Evacuation Notice: All companies prepare for loading into evac transports.
zh: 撤离通知：所有连队准备登上撤离运输机。

en: Hey, buddy. You awake over there?
zh: 嘿，伙计，你那边醒着吗？

en: You were a sight when they brought you in, all blood and puke.
zh: 他们把你带进来时，你那样子真吓人，满身都是血和呕吐物。

en: The medics worked you over and cleaned you up.
zh: 医护兵把你折腾了一番，还把你清理干净了。

en: Don't know why they bothered. They're just gonna kill us all anyway.
zh: 不知道他们为什么费这个劲，反正他们最后也会把我们全杀掉的。

en: Something big is happening. Lots of mercs running around, movin' stuff.
zh: 出大事了，很多雇佣兵跑来跑去，搬东西。

en: Don't know what it is, but I bet....
zh: 不知道是什么，但我敢打赌……

en: Red Faction!
zh: 红色派系！

en: Whichever of you is Parker, come with us -- now!
zh: 你们当中谁是帕克，现在 —— 跟我们走！

en: Unauthorized prisoner release in Cell Block 19. Reinforcements needed.
zh: 19号牢区发生未经授权的囚犯释放，需要增援。

en: Parker! I found your cell and sent down some miners to free you.
zh: 帕克！我找到了你的牢房，并派了一些矿工下去救你。

en: Once you're out, head up to the mercs' HQ. We need your help!
zh: 你一出来，就往雇佣兵总部上去，我们需要你的帮助！

en: C'mon, Parker. We've gotta get out of here!
zh: 快点，帕克，我们得离开这里！

en: Evacuation Notice: F Company should now be in evac transports.
zh: 撤离通知：F连现在应已登上撤离运输机。

en: Parker, I'm in the merc command center. I can see you on the monitors.
zh: 帕克，我在雇佣兵指挥中心，我能在监视器上看到你。

en: There's a squad of miners with me, but the whole base is crawling with mercs.
zh: 我身边有一队矿工，但整个基地到处都是雇佣兵。

en: Code Red Alert. Intruder in mercenary barracks. Security team respond.
zh: 红色代码警报，雇佣兵兵营有入侵者，安保小队响应。

en: Evacuation Notice: E Company should now be in evac transports.
zh: 撤离通知：E连现在应已登上撤离运输机。

en: Parker, Hendrix sent us. C'mon, he's in here!
zh: 帕克，是亨德里克斯派我们来的。快点，他在里面！

en: We'll watch the door. You go talk to Hendrix.
zh: 我们看着门，你去跟亨德里克斯谈。

en: Parker! I didn't think you'd make it. Things look really bad.
zh: 帕克！我没想到你能赶到。情况看起来非常糟糕。

en: I've got just a few miners left with me. Orion has some more, but I lost contact with him.
zh: 我身边只剩几个矿工。奥莱恩那边还有一些人，但我和他失去联系了。

en: We're trying to reach Masako before she sets off the bomb, but the doors to the merc docking bay are sealed.
zh: 我们正试图在雅子引爆炸弹之前找到她，但通往雇佣兵停靠舱的门被封住了。

en: I need access to these mainframes to unlock the doors, but I can't hack into them.
zh: 我需要访问这些大型机来解锁那些门，但我无法侵入它们。

en: If you shut down their power sources, I can hack into the mainframes as they're re-booting.
zh: 如果你关闭它们的电源，我就能在大型机重启时侵入进去。

en: Take the elevator in the hall. Once you're on the upper level, the generators are to the left.
zh: 坐大厅里的电梯。到了上层后，发电机在左边。

en: Barracks perimeter compromised. Battalion security team respond.
zh: 兵营外围遭到突破，营级安保小队响应。

en: Code Red Alert. Mainframe systems compromised. Security team respond.
zh: 红色代码警报，大型机系统遭到入侵，安保小队响应。

en: Red Faction!
zh: 红色派系！

en: Evacuation Notice: D Company should now be in evac transports.
zh: 撤离通知：D连现在应已登上撤离运输机。

en: The emergency shutoff should be on the lowest level of the generator room.
zh: 紧急关闭装置应该在发电机房的最底层。

en: Move it! Get your butts in gear!
zh: 快动！都给我动起来！

en: Code Red Alert. Generator facility compromised. Security team respond.
zh: 红色代码警报，发电机设施遭到入侵，安保小队响应。

en: Main power shut down. Emergency generator on-line. Technician to generator facility.
zh: 主电源已关闭，应急发电机上线，技术员前往发电机设施。

en: Good work, Parker. The mainframes have powered down. They should come back up when the emergency generators kick in.
zh: 干得好，帕克，大型机已经断电。应急发电机启动后，它们应该会重新上线。

en: Here they go...I'm hacking in....
zh: 它们启动了……我正在侵入……

en: Got it! I overrode the door locks. We're coming up -- wait outside the generator room for us.
zh: 搞定！我覆盖了门锁。我们上来了 —— 在发电机房外等我们。

en: You've gotta clear the way, Parker. I have to reach an access panel by the door!
zh: 你得清出道路，帕克。我必须到达门旁的访问面板！

en: OK, let's go!
zh: 好，我们走！

en: Evacuation Notice: C Company should now be in evac transports.
zh: 撤离通知：C连现在应已登上撤离运输机。

en: Hey, where do you think you're goin'?
zh: 嘿，你以为你要去哪儿？

en: Leave me alone, jerk. It's been a long day.
zh: 别烦我，混蛋，今天已经够漫长了。

en: It's about to get a little longer, mine scum!
zh: 那就让它再漫长一点吧，矿渣！

en: Just let me go, or else.
zh: 让我走，不然后果自负。

en: You threatenin' me? Well, threaten this!
zh: 你在威胁我？那就威胁这个吧！

en: Need help! Gotta berserk miner here!
zh: 需要支援！这里有个发疯的矿工！

en: C'mon, Parker! Shift's over.
zh: 快点，帕克！下班了。

en: Second work shift has ended. Miners return to barracks.
zh: 第二班工作已结束，矿工返回兵营。

en: Disturbance in Mine Sector M-4. Code Yellow Alert.
zh: M-4矿区发生骚乱，黄色代码警报。

en: Additional security required in Mine Sector M-4.
zh: M-4矿区需要额外安保。

en: All miners are required to return to their barracks until further notice.
zh: 所有矿工必须返回兵营，直到另行通知。

en: What're you lookin' at, miners?
zh: 你们在看什么，矿工？

en: Help! Help!
zh: 救命！救命！

en: Thanks! Hey, come with me.
zh: 谢谢！嘿，跟我来。

en: A buncha miners are heading up to the docking bay to steal a shuttle.
zh: 一群矿工正往停靠舱去，准备偷一艘航天飞机。

en: They're gonna get off Mars and back to Earth.
zh: 他们要离开火星，回到地球。

en: You help me reach the shuttle, and I'll make sure they take you along.
zh: 你帮我到达航天飞机，我就保证他们带上你。

en: Help, someone! Please help me!
zh: 救命，有人吗！请救救我！

en: Additional security required in Mine Sector M-4.
zh: M-4矿区需要额外安保。

en: Code Red Alert. Additional security required in Mine Sector M-4.
zh: 红色代码警报，M-4矿区需要额外安保。

en: Hey, get over here! We're with the Red Faction!
zh: 嘿，到这边来！我们是红色派系的人！

en: Grab that guard's gun if you need one. He sure doesn't.
zh: 如果需要武器，就拿那名警卫的枪，他肯定用不上了。

en: Stick with us. We're heading to the Red Faction base.
zh: 跟紧我们，我们要去红色派系的基地。

en: Miners! This is Eos, leader of the Red Faction. Our time has come!
zh: 矿工们！我是伊欧丝，红色派系的领袖，我们的时刻到了！

en: Workers in Mine M-4 have started the rebellion. They're fighting and dying for you as I speak!
zh: M-4矿区的工人已经发动起义，此刻他们正在为你们战斗、牺牲！

en: Find the Red Faction members among you. Join us and strike back at Ultor!
zh: 找到你们身边的红色派系成员，加入我们，反击乌尔托！

en: Together, we can...
zh: 团结起来，我们就能……

en: All miners are ordered to ignore unauthorized announcements and return to their barracks immediately.
zh: 命令所有矿工无视未经授权的广播，并立即返回兵营。

en: Damn guards. I hate 'em, I hate 'em, I hate 'em!
zh: 该死的警卫。我恨他们，我恨他们，我恨他们！

en: Red Faction!
zh: 红色派系！

en: Code Red Alert in Mine M-4. Security level 2 response required.
zh: M-4矿区红色代码警报，需要安保等级2响应。

en: Code Red Emergency in Mine M-4. Security level 1 response required.
zh: M-4矿区红色代码紧急状态，需要安保等级1响应。

en: He went this way!
zh: 他往这边走了！

en: Unauthorized vehicle usage in M-4 Driller Bay. Security respond.
zh: M-4钻机舱发生未经授权的车辆使用，安保响应。

en: Remember every dead miner, every injustice, and strike back!
zh: 记住每一个死去的矿工，记住每一桩不公，然后反击！

en: The Red Faction will lead you to freedom.
zh: 红色派系会带领你们走向自由。

en: Run! They're killing everyone in the barracks!
zh: 快跑！他们在兵营里杀所有人！

en: Code Yellow Alert. Disturbance in Barracks C-2. Security respond.
zh: 黄色代码警报，C-2兵营发生骚乱，安保响应。

en: Parker, you don't know me, but my name's Hendrix and I want to help you.
zh: 帕克，你不认识我，但我叫亨德里克斯，我想帮你。

en: I'm a security technician with Ultor. I have my own reasons for hating them and wanting to help you.
zh: 我是乌尔托的一名安保技术员。我有自己的理由憎恨他们，也有理由想帮你。

en: I've been watching the riots on security monitors. You're the only miner from M-4 to make it this far.
zh: 我一直在安保监视器上看着暴乱，你是唯一一个从M-4走到这么远的矿工。

en: Be careful, Parker. Ultor's rushing forces in to block the mines and keep the rebellion from spreading.
zh: 小心点，帕克。乌尔托正在火速调兵封锁矿区，阻止反抗继续扩大。

en: Attention all personnel. Mine M-4 will be sealed in five minutes. All personnel are required to evacuate immediately.
zh: 全体人员注意，M-4矿区将在五分钟后封闭，所有人员必须立即撤离。

en: Well, look at this -- Hendrix has finally come out of hiding!
zh: 哟，看看这是谁 —— 亨德里克斯终于从藏身处出来了！

en: Here's what mercs do to traitors, Hendrix!
zh: 这就是雇佣兵对待叛徒的方式，亨德里克斯！

en: You seem to be almost out of friends, Parker.
zh: 看来你的朋友快用完了，帕克。

en: Here come some of my friends to entertain you.
zh: 我的一些朋友来了，要给你助兴。

en: I'd stay myself, but I have other matters to attend to.
zh: 我倒想亲自留下来，不过我还有别的事情要处理。

en: Evacuation Notice: B Company should now be in evac transports.
zh: 撤离通知：B连现在应已登上撤离运输机。

en: Hurry, Parker -- run for the far doors. I'm going into the control room to help open things up for you.
zh: 快，帕克 —— 往最远的门跑，我去控制室帮你把路打开。

en: Parker...stop them...don't let Ultor get away with...it all....
zh: 帕克……阻止他们……别让乌尔托带着……这一切逃掉……

en: He's in the ventilation system! Flush him out!
zh: 他在通风系统里！把他赶出来！

en: Fan out and secure the hangar!
zh: 散开，确保机库安全！

en: Evacuation Notice: A Company should now be in evac transports.
zh: 撤离通知：A连现在应已登上撤离运输机。

en: First wave of transports is underway.
zh: 第一波运输机正在出发。

en: Second wave of transports is underway.
zh: 第二波运输机正在出发。

en: Final wave of transports is underway.
zh: 最后一波运输机正在出发。

en: Parker, I'm going to be the last person to see you alive.
zh: 帕克，我会成为最后一个看到你活着的人。

en: Maybe I'll pay a visit to your parents when I get back to Earth.
zh: 等我回到地球，也许会去拜访一下你的父母。

en: There won't even be a body for them to sob over. You and the rest of the scum will be vaporized in the blast!
zh: 他们连能哭的尸体都不会有，你和其他渣滓都会在爆炸中蒸发！

en: Parker, don't just stand there gawking -- hurry up!
zh: 帕克，别只是站在那里发呆 —— 快点！

en: Masako set the timer on the bomb before she went up after you. There may be only seconds left.
zh: 雅子追你上去之前就给炸弹设好了计时器，可能只剩几秒了。

en: No time to untie me. Grab the circuit analyzer in my front pocket and attach it to the bomb.
zh: 没时间给我松绑了。拿我胸前口袋里的电路分析仪，把它接到炸弹上。

en: Received circuit analyzer.
zh: 已取得电路分析仪。

en: Masako didn't bother taking it from me. See if you can use it to figure out the bomb's deactivation sequence.
zh: 雅子根本没费心把它从我身上拿走，看看你能不能用它找出炸弹的解除顺序。

en: Circuit analyzer attached to bomb.
zh: 电路分析仪已接入炸弹。

en: Hurry, Parker!
zh: 快，帕克！

en: What's taking so long, Parker?
zh: 怎么花这么久，帕克？

en: C'mon, Parker, c'mon!
zh: 快啊，帕克，快啊！

en: One minute until detonation.
zh: 距离引爆还有一分钟。

en: 30 seconds until detonation.
zh: 距离引爆还有30秒。

en: Ten seconds until detonation.
zh: 距离引爆还有10秒。

en: Detonation.
zh: 引爆。

en: Attention all personnel. Mine M-4 has been sealed.
zh: 全体人员注意，M-4矿区已封闭。

en: Code Red Alert. Security emergency in Barracks C-2. All available personnel respond.
zh: 红色代码警报，C-2兵营发生安保紧急事件，所有可用人员响应。

en: That elevator's been destroyed. You'll have to find another way up.
zh: 那部电梯已经被摧毁了，你得找另一条路上去。

en: Get me out of here! There's a keycard on the desk.
zh: 把我弄出去！桌上有一张钥匙卡。

en: I think the guards forgot about me. Let me out before they come back!
zh: 我估计警卫已经把我忘了，趁他们回来前让我出去！

en: I can help you escape. Some miners are grabbing a shuttle and getting off Mars.
zh: 我能帮你逃出去，有些矿工正在抢一艘航天飞机，准备离开火星。

en: Thanks! Follow me!
zh: 谢谢！跟我来！

en: I think I can still get you to the docking bay, Parker.
zh: 我想我还能把你带到停靠舱，帕克。

en: Security to Miner Barracks C-2. Security to Barracks C-2.
zh: 安保前往矿工兵营C-2，安保前往兵营C-2。

en: Additional security needed in Miner Barracks C-2.
zh: 矿工兵营C-2需要额外安保。

en: All miners are ordered to lay down their weapons and report to the nearest security checkpoint. You will not be harmed.
zh: 所有矿工立刻放下武器，前往最近的安保检查站报到，你们不会受到伤害。

en: Damn miners!
zh: 该死的矿工！

en: Stop, please! I surrender!
zh: 停下，求你！我投降！

en: There'll be one fewer of you rats when I'm done!
zh: 等我收拾完，你们这些耗子就会少一个！

en: There's another one. Get him!
zh: 那边还有一个，干掉他！

en: If I can reach someone in the Red Faction, I'll ask how you can link up with them. I'll let you know....
zh: 我要是能联系上红色派系的人，就帮你问问怎么和他们会合，有消息我会告诉你……

en: Help! Help! Can anyone hear me? Help!
zh: 救命！救命！有人听得见吗？救命！

en: No, stop, please! I'll go back to work!
zh: 不，停下，求你！我会回去工作的！

en: Too late for that, mine scum!
zh: 现在太迟了，矿渣！

en: Intruder in Guard Training Facility. Security response required.
zh: 警卫训练设施有入侵者，需要安保响应。

en: Dark...so dark...can't see. I can hear you...sound like a miner. Get up to the docking bay...ship leaving....
zh: 好黑……太黑了……看不见。我能听见你……听起来像个矿工。上到停靠舱去……飞船要走了……

en: You're hearin' things.
zh: 你听错了。

en: Shut up, idiot. I heard shots, and they're not answering their comm sets.
zh: 闭嘴，白痴。我听到了枪声，而且他们没有回应通讯器。

en: Johnson? Farris? Are you OK?
zh: 约翰逊？法里斯？你们没事吧？

en: Security team needed in docking bay processing area.
zh: 停靠舱处理区需要安保小队。

en: Intruders in C-2 maintenance tunnels. Security response required.
zh: C-2维护隧道有入侵者，需要安保响应。

en: There's a back route into the docking bay up ahead, if it's not blocked.
zh: 前面有条后路能进入停靠舱，如果没被堵住的话。

en: The escaping miners came this way too. The elevators ahead were destroyed in the fighting. You'll have to climb up.
zh: 逃走的矿工也是从这边过去的。前面的电梯在战斗中被摧毁了。你得爬上去。

en: The trams aren't running anymore, Parker. Ultor's cutting off the miners every way they can.
zh: 电车已经不运行了，帕克，乌尔托正在用尽一切办法切断矿工的退路。

en: Code Red Alert. Disturbance in Docking Bay 2. Security response required.
zh: 红色代码警报，2号停靠舱发生骚乱，需要安保响应。

en: Security to Registration tramway. Intruder apprehended and awaiting escort.
zh: 安保前往登记电车轨道，入侵者已被逮捕，等待押送。

en: Don't panic, Parker. I should be able to hack the doors open in a minute or two.
zh: 别慌，帕克，我应该能在一两分钟内黑开这些门。

en: OK, now you can panic. There are guards coming....
zh: 好吧，现在你可以慌了，有警卫来了……

en: Hold on, I've almost got it.... There!
zh: 撑住，我快搞定了……好了！

en: I hear we're getting wiped out in the mines. Where are the mercs who're supposed to back us up?
zh: 我听说我们在矿井里快被打垮了，那些本该支援我们的雇佣兵去哪儿了？

en: Forget 'em. We can handle these miners.
zh: 别管他们，我们能对付这些矿工。

en: Code Yellow Alert. Intruder in Miner Registration. Security respond.
zh: 黄色代码警报，矿工登记处有入侵者，安保响应。

en: Code Yellow Alert. Intruder in Registration Medical Facility. Security respond.
zh: 黄色代码警报，登记医疗设施有入侵者，安保响应。

en: Hurry, Parker. The miners are at the shuttle.
zh: 快点，帕克，矿工们已经到航天飞机那儿了。

en: There they go. If only you'd been faster....
zh: 他们走了，要是你快一点就好了……

en: Maybe being slow isn't such a bad thing.
zh: 也许慢一点也不是坏事。

en: Intruders in Docking Bay 2. Security to Docking Bay 2.
zh: 2号停靠舱有入侵者，安保前往2号停靠舱。

en: The docking bay's unpressurized now. You have to shut its emergency doors before this door will open.
zh: 停靠舱现在已经失压。你必须先关闭它的应急门，这扇门才会打开。

en: Security Unit 27 responding. Over.
zh: 安保单位27响应。完毕。

en: Let's go, let's go!
zh: 走，走，走！

en: That did it. Once the docking bay's pressurized, the containment door will retract.
zh: 成了。等停靠舱增压完成，隔离门就会收回。

en: That explosion blew out the docking bay door. Before you can enter, you need to activate the emergency doors from the control room.
zh: 那次爆炸炸开了停靠舱门。在进入之前，你需要从控制室启动应急门。

en: Security breach in Geothermal Plant #4. Additional units requested.
zh: 4号地热发电厂发生安保漏洞，请求增派单位。

en: Intruder in Docking Bay 4. Security to Docking Bay 4.
zh: 4号停靠舱有入侵者，安保前往4号停靠舱。

en: Intruder in Docking Bay 4 maintenance facility. Security respond.
zh: 4号停靠舱维护设施有入侵者，安保响应。

en: I don't see anyone.
zh: 我没看到任何人。

en: Someone triggered the alarms. Split up and check all the storerooms.
zh: 有人触发了警报。分头行动，检查所有储藏室。

en: There should be a control panel somewhere to open the containment door.
zh: 应该有个控制面板能打开隔离门。

en: Careful down here, Parker. The guards are sweeping all the mines, killing everyone.
zh: 下面小心，帕克。警卫正在扫荡所有矿井，杀掉所有人。

en: The door's jammed. Blast around it, if you can.
zh: 门卡住了。如果可以，就从旁边炸开。

en: All non-security personnel are required to return to their barracks for the duration of the disturbances.
zh: 所有非安保人员必须在骚乱期间返回兵营。

en: I'm trying to override the door's circuitry to force it open for you, Parker. Give me a minute....
zh: 我正在尝试覆盖这扇门的电路，强行帮你打开。给我一分钟，帕克……

en: Who's there? Drop your weapon and show yourself!
zh: 谁在那里？放下武器，现身！

en: If you can stay alive until we fight our way back up, we'll find you.
zh: 如果你能活到我们一路打回来，我们会找到你的。

en: There are squads of miners somewhere ahead of you, Parker. Try to link up with them.
zh: 前面某处有几队矿工，帕克，试着和他们会合。

en: The elevator ahead should take you down to Level N-17, fairly close to the Red Faction base.
zh: 前面的电梯应该能把你带到N-17层，离红色派系基地相当近。

en: Careful down here, Parker. This mine section was abandoned years ago and it's none too stable.
zh: 下面小心，帕克。这片矿区多年前就被废弃了，而且很不稳定。

en: There are more groups of miners moving ahead of you. Eos must be after something important.
zh: 还有更多矿工队伍在你前方移动，伊欧丝一定是在找什么重要东西。

en: There should be a ventilation opening in here that'll take you to the miners I spotted.
zh: 这里应该有个通风口，能带你去我发现的那些矿工那里。

en: C'mon, before those guards catch up!
zh: 快点，别被那些警卫追上！

en: Parker, we need your help. We're trying to knock out an Ultor geothermal power plant in this sector.
zh: 帕克，我们需要你的帮助，我们正试图摧毁这个区域的一座乌尔托地热发电厂。

en: If the power's knocked out, we can launch a major attack. But our squads are running into stiff resistance.
zh: 如果电力被切断，我们就能发动一场大规模进攻。但我们的小队遭遇了顽强抵抗。

en: If you can help them take out the power plant, I can send more miners up to join you.
zh: 如果你能帮他们摧毁发电厂，我就能派更多矿工上去加入你们。

en: Wait, I'm on your side! Ultor has ambushes all over this area. They're slaughtering the miners ahead of you. They're...
zh: 等等，我是你这边的！乌尔托在这片区域到处设了埋伏。他们正在屠杀你前面的矿工。他们……

en: Parker! One of my squads is pinned down inside the ventilation system. Can you help them out?
zh: 帕克！我的一支小队被困在通风系统里了，能帮他们脱身吗？

en: ...tell Eos we tried...but...sniper on crusher...
zh: ……告诉伊欧丝我们试过了……可是……破碎机上有狙击手……

en: All miners report to the nearest guard station. You will not be harmed.
zh: 所有矿工前往最近的警卫站报到，你们不会受到伤害。

en: I just overrode the controls for the bridge, Parker. Hurry across!
zh: 我刚覆盖了桥的控制，帕克，快过去！

en: Parker? I've lost touch with everyone else up there. I think you're all we have left.
zh: 帕克？我和上面其他人都失去联系了，我想只剩你还能指望了。

en: Help! Help!
zh: 救命！救命！

en: Red Faction!
zh: 红色派系！

en: Until the power's cut to Ultor's monitoring systems, they know every move we make. We're getting mowed down. I hope you can do it, Parker.
zh: 只要乌尔托的监控系统还没断电，他们就知道我们的一举一动。我们快被打烂了。希望你能办到，帕克。

en: There's a route past the old rock crusher that should get you to the power plant, Parker.
zh: 穿过旧碎石机那边有条路，应该能带你到发电厂，帕克。

en: All miners report to the nearest guard station. You will not be harmed.
zh: 所有矿工前往最近的警卫站报到，你们不会受到伤害。

en: Nah, you'll see. Ultor knows what they're doing. This'll all be over soon.
zh: 别急，你会明白的。乌尔托知道自己在做什么。这事很快就会结束。

en: That's not what I heard. Things're goin' bad all over.
zh: 我听到的可不是这样。到处都出大事了。

en: Who's there? Show yourself, hands in the air!
zh: 谁在那里？出来，双手举高！

en: Sorry, my bad!
zh: 抱歉，我的错！

en: Backpressure building in water reclamation system. Immediate technician attention required.
zh: 水回收系统背压上升，需要技术员立即处理。

en: There are five facilities to sabotage -- turbines, water control, water reclamation, lava control, and the main controls.
zh: 需要破坏五处设施 —— 涡轮机、水控制、水回收、熔岩控制和主控制。

en: Water intake exceeding outflow. Turbine chambers flooding.
zh: 进水量超过排水量，涡轮室正在进水。

en: Who's down there? Throw down your weapons and come out!
zh: 下面是谁？扔下武器，出来！

en: Steam pressure approaching dangerous levels.
zh: 蒸汽压力正在接近危险水平。

en: At 100 bucks a head, I'm gonna shoot every miner I see!
zh: 一个人头100块，我见到矿工就开枪！

en: Forget the miners. It's the mercs I'm worried about. They give me the creeps.
zh: 别管矿工了，我担心的是雇佣兵。那帮家伙让我心里发毛。

en: Destroy both pump stations. That'll force even more water into the system.
zh: 摧毁两座泵站，这样会把更多水逼进系统里。

en: Wait, Parker! Hit the main control room last, after sabotaging the other systems.
zh: 等等，帕克！先破坏其他系统，最后再动主控制室。

en: Lava flow exceeding safe operational parameters.
zh: 熔岩流量超过安全运行参数。

en: Geothermal plant turbines overloading. Shut down all systems immediately.
zh: 地热发电厂涡轮机过载，立即关闭所有系统。

en: Additional security needed in Geothermal Plant #4.
zh: 地热发电厂4号需要增派安保。

en: All units are now on Code Red. Repeat. Code Red conditions are in effect.
zh: 所有单位现在进入红色警戒。重复，红色警戒已生效。

en: Intruder in Geothermal Plant 4. Apprehend or neutralize immediately.
zh: 地热发电厂4号发现入侵者，立即逮捕或击毙。

en: Don't shoot, I'm on your side! C'mon down here.
zh: 别开枪，我是自己人！快下来。

en: Go to the other control panel and find the override button.
zh: 去另一块控制面板，找到超控按钮。

en: You see that button? You have to press it while I press this one.
zh: 看到那个按钮了吗？我按这个的时候，你得同时按下它。

en: Didn't work. Let's try again. Don't press until I say 'go!'
zh: 没成功，再来一次。我说“按”之前别按！

en: Cut the chatter and keep sharp. Shoot anything that moves.
zh: 少废话，打起精神来，会动的全打掉。

en: Turbine chamber pressure at critical levels. Anomalous event imminent.
zh: 涡轮室压力达到临界水平，即将发生异常事件。

en: The rest of the plant is probably rubble. You'll have to go out through the sub bay.
zh: 发电厂其他地方大概已经成废墟了，你得从潜艇舱出去。

en: The tech in the main control room is on our side. Once you've sabotaged the other four systems, get in there and he'll know what to do.
zh: 主控制室里的技术员是我们的人。等你破坏另外四个系统后，就进去找他，他知道该怎么做。

en: Turbine chamber pressure returning to operational parameters. Code Red canceled.
zh: 涡轮室压力恢复至运行参数，红色警戒取消。

en: Stop them! Turn off those overrides!
zh: 阻止他们！关掉那些超控！

en: Hurry up, guards will be here soon.
zh: 快点，警卫马上就到。

en: Hendrix says you made it into the geothermal plant.
zh: 亨德里克斯说你进了地热发电厂。

en: Geothermal plant inoperative. Containment shields in place.
zh: 地热发电厂停止运转，防护屏障已就位。

en: Hurry up, Parker. There should be a release button in the control room and a manual release on the winch.
zh: 快点，帕克。控制室里应该有释放按钮，绞盘上还有一个手动释放装置。

en: Ultor has an underwater lab somewhere down there. If you can get inside, I've got a job for you.
zh: 乌尔托在下面某处有个水下实验室。你要是能进去，我有件事要你办。

en: I dunno what it was. Why don't you go check it out?
zh: 我不知道那是什么，你为什么不去看看？

en: I'm not goin' anywhere. You go and I'll watch the sub.
zh: 我哪儿也不去。你去，我看着潜艇。

en: Let's just wait. Command'll tell us if they want it checked out.
zh: 等着吧。指挥部要是想让我们查，会告诉我们的。

en: Up, down, up, down. I hate ladders.
zh: 上、下、上、下。我讨厌梯子。

en: You should see the research center in the cavern ahead.
zh: 你应该能看到前方洞穴里的研究中心。

en: ...concern. Do your job and Ultor'll take care of us.
zh: ……担心。干好你的活，乌尔托会照顾我们的。

en: Why haven't we been relieved yet? The second shift should have been here by now.
zh: 怎么还没人来换班？第二班早该到了。

en: They'll be here. Just get your work done.
zh: 他们会来的，把你的活干完就行。

en: Parker, I want you to grab someone. I need you to go into Admin and kidnap Gryphon, Ultor's Deputy Administrator.
zh: 帕克，我要你抓一个人。你得进行政区，绑架格里芬，乌尔托的副行政主管。

en: Let's go -- get your butts down here!
zh: 走了 —— 都给我下来！

en: Sarge? You there, Sarge?
zh: 中士？你在吗，中士？

en: There's a miner waiting for you by the stairs to Admin. Put on the suit he gives you; it's the only way you'll reach Gryphon.
zh: 行政区楼梯旁有个矿工在等你。穿上他给你的衣服，这是接近格里芬的唯一办法。

en: Parker, over here, behind the stairs!
zh: 帕克，这边，楼梯后面！

en: Got a monkey suit for you, Parker. Put it on and keep it on.
zh: 给你弄了套猴子装，帕克。穿上，别脱下来。

en: Give me your weapons. They're too bulky to carry beneath the suit.
zh: 把武器给我。那些东西太大了，藏不进衣服底下。

en: Take this silenced pistol. Keep it holstered under your suit. Use it only when you absolutely have to.
zh: 拿着这把消音手枪，把它收在衣服下面，不到万不得已别用它。

en: Parker, come back! You'll never make it!
zh: 帕克，回来！你过不去的！

en: I think Gryphon knows all about the Plague. Once we have him, we can wring some answers out of him.
zh: 我觉得格里芬知道瘟疫的一切。抓到他以后，我们就能从他嘴里逼出答案。

en: You are not authorized for entry to this area. Access denied.
zh: 你无权进入该区域，拒绝访问。

en: This is a high-security area. Be careful.
zh: 这里是高安全区域，小心点。

en: Keep your weapon hidden and don't get too close to anyone.
zh: 把武器藏好，别离任何人太近。

en: Posters of you are everywhere. Guards might recognize you if you get too close.
zh: 到处都贴着你的通缉海报。要是你靠得太近，警卫可能会认出你。

en: And if you have to kill someone, hide the body!
zh: 如果你非得杀人，就把尸体藏起来！

en: Gryphon's office is on the third floor of the Admin area, Parker.
zh: 格里芬的办公室在行政区三楼，帕克。

en: This elevator's not usually locked. Must be an additional security measure.
zh: 这部电梯平时不会锁。肯定是额外安保措施。

en: You'll need to take a passcard off an exec. Whatever you do, don't cap him out in the open!
zh: 你得从一名高管身上弄到通行卡。无论如何，别在大庭广众下毙了他！

en: Watch out for cameras. If you get too close, a tech might recognize you.
zh: 小心摄像头。你靠得太近的话，技术员可能会认出你。

en: Remember, Parker, we want Gryphon alive.
zh: 记住，帕克，我们要格里芬活着。

en: Miners are dying of the Plague down here. If Gryphon knows anything about it, we have to get it out of him.
zh: 下面的矿工正在死于瘟疫。格里芬要是知道什么，我们就必须从他嘴里撬出来。

en: Security breach in Administration. Additional units requested.
zh: 行政区发生安保突破，请求增派单位。

en: Hey, you're that miner they're looking for!
zh: 嘿，你就是他们在找的那个矿工！

en: What's been eating Gryphon lately?
zh: 格里芬最近怎么了？

en: I don't know, but something's up.
zh: 不知道，但肯定有事。

en: Think it's the miner strike?
zh: 你觉得是矿工罢工？

en: No, that's under control. It's something else...
zh: 不，那事已经控制住了。是别的……

en: Take the lower hallway that leads to the left. I have a surprise for you, but hurry up!
zh: 走左边下面那条走廊，我给你准备了个惊喜，不过得快点！

en: Go through the door to your right.
zh: 从你右边的门进去。

en: Go through the door to your left.
zh: 从你左边的门进去。

en: Hi, Parker. Just wanted to see you in person for a change.
zh: 嗨，帕克。我只是想换个方式，亲眼见见你。

en: I have to stay here, where I can do the most good.
zh: 我得留在这里，这样最能帮上忙。

en: Parker, do you have Gryphon yet?
zh: 帕克，你抓到格里芬了吗？

en: I'm sending a squad to meet you and bring Gryphon down here.
zh: 我派一支小队去接应你，把格里芬带到这儿来。

en: Security breach in Administration. Additional units requested.
zh: 行政区发生安保突破，请求增派单位。

en: It's creepy having all these guards around. When will they go away?
zh: 周围全是警卫，真瘆人。他们什么时候才走？

en: As soon as the miners go back to work. Not long now.
zh: 等矿工回去工作的时候，快了。

en: This is exec land. Be extra careful in here. Security is very tight.
zh: 这里是高管区，在这里要格外小心，安保非常严格。

en: Parker, I don't trust Gryphon. It's too easy. Watch for a trap.
zh: 帕克，我不信任格里芬。太顺利了，小心有诈。

en: Excuse me, sir. Do you have an appointment?
zh: 打扰一下，先生。您有预约吗？

en: Wait! You can't go in there!
zh: 等等！你不能进去！

en: I'm sorry, but Mr. Gryphon is busy now. Would you like to make an appointment?
zh: 抱歉，格里芬先生现在很忙。您要预约吗？

en: All right, Mr. Gryphon. Have a nice tour, Mr. Smith.
zh: 好的，格里芬先生。祝您参观愉快，史密斯先生。

en: Sandy, I have to show Mr. Smith here around. Be back in a couple of hours.
zh: 桑迪，我得带这位史密斯先生四处看看，几个小时后回来。

en: Stay calm and we'll be fine. Don't make the guards suspicious.
zh: 冷静点，我们就没事，别让警卫起疑。

en: And don't take that gun out again, whatever you do.
zh: 还有，不管怎样，别再把那把枪掏出来。

en: Come on. This is the quickest way out of here.
zh: 走吧，这是离开这里最快的路。

en: Hey, I could get $25,000 for turning you in. Wow!
zh: 嘿，把你交出去我能拿到25000美元，哇哦！

en: Just kidding, Parker.
zh: 开玩笑的，帕克。

en: Follow my lead and we'll be OK.
zh: 照我说的做，我们就没事。

en: You lead the way.
zh: 你带路。

en: Quit fooling around. I'm risking my life here!
zh: 别胡闹了，我可是在拿命冒险！

en: Hurry up, Parker.
zh: 快点，帕克。

en: Not the elevator. This way.
zh: 不是电梯，走这边。

en: That's a dead end. We need to take the ramp down.
zh: 那是死路，我们得走坡道下去。

en: This door leads to storage and maintenance. We can escape that way.
zh: 这扇门通往仓储和维护区，我们可以从那边逃出去。

en: Run! They're on to us!
zh: 跑！他们发现我们了！

en: You might want that envirosuit, Parker.
zh: 你最好拿上那套环境服，帕克。

en: It'll be more protection than that badly fitting thing you're wearing now.
zh: 它比你现在穿的那件不合身的破玩意儿更能保护你。

en: Security breach in Administration. Additional units requested.
zh: 行政区发生安保突破，请求增派单位。

en: You shouldn't have done that. Good secretaries are hard to find.
zh: 你不该那么做，好秘书可不好找。

en: Going for a swim, sir?
zh: 要去游泳吗，先生？

en: Lose your way, sir?
zh: 迷路了吗，先生？

en: This guy's playing some angle, Parker. Don't let your guard down.
zh: 这家伙肯定在打什么算盘，帕克，别放松警惕。

en: You're in the bot repair shops now, Parker. Eos's squad should meet you soon.
zh: 你现在进了机器人维修车间，帕克。伊欧丝的小队应该很快会和你会合。

en: The fence can't be turned off from this side.
zh: 这边关不了电网。

en: I can't open the door. The lock on the other side ate my passcard.
zh: 我打不开门。另一边的锁把我的通行卡吞了。

en: You get me to Eos, Parker. I've got enough dirt on Ultor to bury them forever.
zh: 把我带到伊欧丝那里，帕克。我掌握的乌尔托黑料足够把他们彻底埋了。

en: Ultor's been causing the Plague. Some sort of experiment.
zh: 瘟疫就是乌尔托搞出来的，某种实验。

en: It's all Capek's fault. He's the head of Ultor's science and medical labs on Mars.
zh: 全是卡佩克的错，他是乌尔托火星科学和医学实验室的负责人。

en: I'll tell Eos all about it.
zh: 我会把一切都告诉伊欧丝。

en: Do you have to kill everyone you meet?
zh: 你非得杀掉每个见到的人吗？

en: They wouldn't have hurt you!
zh: 他们不会伤害你的！

en: My squad's almost reached the maintenance area, Parker. Keep Gryphon alive until you meet them.
zh: 我的小队快到维护区了，帕克。在见到他们之前，让格里芬活着。

en: Orion, my best lieutenant, is leading the squad.
zh: 奥莱恩，我最得力的副手，正在带队。

en: Stay here, I'll wave us in.
zh: 留在这儿，我来帮我们混过去。

en: Okay, move!
zh: 好了，走！

en: I'll wait here. You secure the way ahead.
zh: 我在这儿等，你去确保前面的路安全。

en: This way.
zh: 这边。

en: Um, wait. My mistake. Took a wrong turn.
zh: 呃，等等，是我搞错了，走错路了。

en: Follow me. There's a hidden door over here.
zh: 跟我来，这边有一道暗门。

en: I don't like this, Parker. Keep an eye on him.
zh: 我不喜欢这样，帕克，盯紧他。

en: You open the door, Parker. You're the one with the gun.
zh: 你来开门，帕克，拿枪的是你。

en: Parker, Orion's squad has hit heavy resistance and is pinned down.
zh: 帕克，奥莱恩的小队遭到强力抵抗，被压制住了。

en: You'll need to bring Gryphon to them, if you can.
zh: 可以的话，你得把格里芬带去他们那里。

en: I just remembered. The techs have been working on a flying vehicle for the mercenaries.
zh: 我刚想起来，技术员一直在给雇佣兵研发一种飞行载具。

en: They call it the Aesir. It's just a prototype, but the techs claim it's fully functional.
zh: 他们叫它埃西尔，只是原型机，但技术员说它完全能用。

en: The testing grounds aren't far. If we can grab one, it'll be a lot safer than walking.
zh: 试验场不远。要是能抢到一架，会比走路安全得多。

en: Go for it, Parker. But watch for traps.
zh: 上吧，帕克，小心陷阱。

en: Hendrix told me about the Aesir, Parker. If you can get one, we could sure use it.
zh: 亨德里克斯跟我说过埃西尔，帕克。你要是能弄到一架，我们正好用得上。

en: You first, Parker.
zh: 你先走，帕克。

en: My leg!
zh: 我的腿！

en: I can't walk, you'll have to carry me.
zh: 我走不了了，你得背我。

en: Wait, Parker, you can't just leave me here. Eos and the Red Faction need me!
zh: 等等，帕克，你不能就这么把我丢在这里。伊欧丝和红色派系需要我！

en: The weasel's right, Parker. We need him.
zh: 那只黄鼠狼说得没错，帕克，我们需要他。

en: The launch bay is just down this elevator.
zh: 发射舱就在这部电梯下面。

en: Hurry, head for the fighter!
zh: 快，去战机那边！

en: Looks like there's a connection in the ceiling to some sort of natural cavern, Parker.
zh: 天花板上好像有条通向某种天然洞穴的连接口，帕克。

en: Security response required in maintenance and storage facility.
zh: 维护和仓储设施需要安保响应。

en: Additional security needed in maintenance and storage facility.
zh: 维护和仓储设施需要增派安保。

en: There's a checkpoint ahead. I'll wave us through.
zh: 前面有个检查站，我来帮我们混过去。

en: Looks like you'll have to blast through.
zh: 看来你得炸过去了。

en: Did you disable the turrets on the far side?
zh: 你关掉远端的炮塔了吗？

en: I've never been down here before. I have no idea which way to go.
zh: 我以前从没来过这里，完全不知道该走哪边。

en: Watch out!
zh: 小心！

en: You're going to get me killed!
zh: 你要害死我了！

en: Don't push your luck, Parker. Remember, you've got valuable cargo -- me!
zh: 别得寸进尺，帕克。记住，你带着贵重货物 —— 我！

en: Move faster, Parker!
zh: 快点走，帕克！

en: You want me to drive?
zh: 要我来开吗？

en: The opening in the cavern wall should lead toward Orion's position.
zh: 洞穴墙上的开口应该通往奥莱恩的位置。

en: Intruder in Aesir maintenance facility. Code Red Alert.
zh: 埃西尔维护设施发现入侵者，红色警戒。

en: Intruder in Aesir testing grounds. Security respond.
zh: 埃西尔试验场发现入侵者，安保响应。

en: We can't get out here.
zh: 我们不能从这儿出去。

en: Parker, clear out this area before you try to land.
zh: 帕克，先清空这片区域，再尝试着陆。

en: This is Ultor's main trash disposal facility, Parker.
zh: 这里是乌尔托的主要垃圾处理设施，帕克。

en: I can't see Orion's group on my monitors anymore.
zh: 我的监视器上已经看不到奥莱恩的小队了。

en: That's an Ultor Personnel Suppression combot. I didn't know they had any on Mars!
zh: 那是乌尔托人员镇压战斗机器人，我都不知道他们在火星上有这种东西！

en: That thing's your problem, Parker, not mine!
zh: 那东西是你的麻烦，帕克，不是我的！

en: There's a disposal pit at the lowest point of this level.
zh: 这一层最低处有个处理坑。

en: Try to lure the bot out onto the pit's covering, then open the doors from the control room.
zh: 试着把机器人引到坑盖上，然后从控制室打开门。

en: Parker, you're not far from Ultor's science and medical labs.
zh: 帕克，你离乌尔托的科学和医学实验室不远了。

en: If you decide to go after Dr. Capek, be very careful, Parker.
zh: 如果你决定去找卡佩克博士，一定要非常小心，帕克。

en: The labs are heavily guarded, and Capek is a very nasty creature.
zh: 实验室警卫森严，而且卡佩克是个非常恶毒的家伙。

en: There's a vent that leads to the labs, but you're not going to like it.
zh: 有条通风管通往实验室，但你不会喜欢它的位置。

en: It's inside the disposal pit. There's an access ladder that leads down to it.
zh: 它在处理坑里面。有架检修梯可以下去。

en: Security team required in trash disposal facility.
zh: 垃圾处理设施需要安保小队。

en: You're somewhere above the med labs now, Parker.
zh: 你现在应该在医学实验室上方的某处，帕克。

en: Try to pick a quiet spot to come down out of the vent.
zh: 尽量找个安静的地方从通风管下来。

en: Hmm. He's fading fast. I'd better get the doctor.
zh: 唔，他快不行了，我最好去叫医生。

en: Unnnhhhh...
zh: 呃呃呃……

en: You need a lab coat or you'll have every guard in here down on you.
zh: 你需要一件实验服，不然这里所有警卫都会扑向你。

en: There's a doctor's office right next to this room.
zh: 这间房旁边就有一间医生办公室。

en: Don't count on that disguise too much though.
zh: 不过别太指望那套伪装。

en: Anyone who gets a good look at you could recognize you.
zh: 谁要是仔细看你一眼，都可能认出你。

en: Parker, Gryphon's told us a lot more than we ever wanted to know about the Plague.
zh: 帕克，格里芬告诉我们的瘟疫真相，比我们想知道的还多。

en: You have to grab Capek. He's the key to the whole thing.
zh: 你必须抓住卡佩克，他是整件事的关键。

en: Don't kill him -- hundreds of miners' lives depend on it!
zh: 别杀他 —— 几百名矿工的命都靠他了！

en: Capek'll be in the science labs, past the med labs.
zh: 卡佩克会在科学实验室，在医学实验室后面。

en: Security breach in Medical Labs. Additional units requested.
zh: 医学实验室发生安保突破，请求增派单位。

en: Doc? You've gotta give me something for the pain...
zh: 医生？你得给我点止痛的东西……

en: Let me take a look at your charts.
zh: 让我看看你的病历。

en: Who made these notations? I can't even read them!
zh: 这些注释是谁写的？我根本看不懂！

en: I just need some air.
zh: 我只是需要透口气。

en: But the results seem promising, you must admit.
zh: 但你必须承认，结果看起来很有希望。

en: Not enough for Capek. The man is fanatical.
zh: 对卡佩克来说还不够，那人已经疯魔了。

en: This specimen has developed nicely, perhaps enough to satisfy even Capek.
zh: 这个样本发育得很好，也许连卡佩克都会满意。

en: We'll see, once the organs are delivered to the science labs.
zh: 等器官送到科学实验室，我们就知道了。

en: It's almost as sickening out here as it is in there.
zh: 外面这里几乎和里面一样恶心。

en: Shall we bring him back to the ward, doctor?
zh: 医生，要把他送回病房吗？

en: No, keep him here on life support in case we need to harvest more.
zh: 不，把他留在这里维持生命，以防我们还需要采集更多东西。

en: Yes, doctor.
zh: 是，医生。

en: You're late. The organs are already on the specimen ward.
zh: 你迟到了，器官已经在样本病房了。

en: Take them to the labs right away.
zh: 马上把它们送去实验室。

en: I'll be in my office if his condition changes.
zh: 如果他的情况有变化，我会在办公室。

en: You'd better hurry. The organs won't keep for long. It'll be your fault if they're unusable.
zh: 你最好快点，器官保存不了太久。要是不能用了，就是你的责任。

en: They're over here.
zh: 就在这边。

en: Go along with this, Parker. It might help you slip past checkpoints easier.
zh: 配合一下，帕克，这也许能让你更容易通过检查站。

en: Oooooh [low, wordless moan of pain]
zh: 噢噢噢 [低沉的无词痛哼]

en: Arrrr [low, wordless moan of pain]
zh: 啊啊啊 [低沉的无词痛哼]

en: Good. Now hurry up -- don't keep them waiting in the lab.
zh: 很好，现在快点 —— 别让实验室里的人等急了。

en: Actually, compared to just a year ago, our failure rate is much lower.
zh: 其实和一年前相比，我们的失败率已经低多了。

en: I know, but the wasted resources still bother me.
zh: 我知道，但浪费掉的资源还是让我很在意。

en: Security breach in Science Labs. Additional units requested.
zh: 科学实验室发生安保突破，请求增派单位。

en: Sorry, sir. This area is restricted to authorized personnel only.
zh: 抱歉，先生，该区域仅限授权人员进入。

en: We've been expecting you, doctor. They're waiting for the sample in the operating room.
zh: 我们一直在等您，医生，他们在手术室等样本。

en: ...transplating fresh organs to replace those lost to the ravages of nanotech...
zh: ……移植新鲜器官，以替换被纳米技术摧残而失去的器官……

en: Parker, I've been studying the labs' security system.
zh: 帕克，我一直在研究实验室的安保系统。

en: There's a security door you have to pass to reach Capek's lab.
zh: 要到卡佩克的实验室，你必须通过一道安全门。

en: The medical lab administrator should have a passcard.
zh: 医学实验室管理员应该有通行卡。

en: Can I help you, doctor?
zh: 需要帮忙吗，医生？

en: That's OK, Parker. Take your time. The miners dying of the Plague won't mind.
zh: 没关系，帕克，慢慢来。那些死于瘟疫的矿工不会介意的。

en: This specimen's paperwork needs the administrator's signature before I can accept it.
zh: 这个样本的文件需要管理员签名，我才能接收。

en: All the paperwork's in order. Go on in, doctor.
zh: 文件都没问题。进去吧，医生。

en: There you go. You'd better get that to Cryo right away.
zh: 好了，你最好马上把它送去冷冻室。

en: That needs to be brought to the OR, sir. This is the Cryo Lab.
zh: 那个需要送到手术室，先生。这里是冷冻实验室。

en: Ah, at last, the replacement brainstem has arrived.
zh: 啊，终于，替换脑干到了。

en: Thank you. Please take this one to Cryo.
zh: 谢谢，请把这个送去冷冻室。

en: Received signed authorization.
zh: 已收到签署授权书。

en: I'll buzz you through to the administrator, doctor, so he can sign those.
zh: 医生，我帮您接通管理员那边，让他签这些文件。

en: Doctor, you can't go in there!
zh: 医生，你不能进去！

en: I'm sorry, doctor. The administrator is very busy.
zh: 抱歉，医生。管理员现在很忙。

en: The administrator is just upstairs, doctor.
zh: 管理员就在楼上，医生。

en: Security breach in Science Labs. Additional units requested.
zh: 科学实验室发生安保突破，请求增派单位。

en: The OR is up this ramp.
zh: 手术室就在这条坡道上面。

en: ...transplating fresh organs to replace those lost to the ravages of nanotech...
zh: ……移植新鲜器官，以替换被纳米技术摧残而失去的器官……

en: Parker, I've been studying the labs' security system.
zh: 帕克，我一直在研究实验室的安保系统。

en: There's a security door you have to pass to reach Capek's lab.
zh: 要到卡佩克的实验室，你必须通过一道安全门。

en: The medical lab administrator should have a passcard.
zh: 医学实验室管理员应该有通行卡。

en: His office is in the middle of the complex.
zh: 他的办公室在设施中央。

en: You have to kill the administrator to get a passcard.
zh: 你必须杀掉管理员才能拿到通行卡。

en: Capek headed out that way, Parker.
zh: 卡佩克往那边去了，帕克。

en: I can't see into this area. There aren't any security cameras here.
zh: 我看不到这个区域，这里没有安保摄像头。

en: I see you, Parker. I will deal with you later.
zh: 我看到你了，帕克。我待会儿再收拾你。

en: Perhaps you might even be persuaded to join one of my experiments?
zh: 也许还能说服你加入我的某个实验？

en: Orion got Gryphon to the Red Faction base, Parker.
zh: 奥莱恩已经把格里芬带到红色派系基地了，帕克。

en: Eos should be picking his brain right now.
zh: 伊欧丝现在应该正在撬他的脑袋。

en: Still there, Parker? Your persistence is beginning to annoy me.
zh: 还在吗，帕克？你的执着开始让我烦了。

en: No matter. Very soon you will be irrelevant.
zh: 没关系，很快你就无关紧要了。

en: 'Where could we be going?' I hear you wonder. Soon you will know, Parker.
zh: “我们会去哪儿呢？”我听见了你在好奇，很快你就会知道的，帕克。

en: Parker, Gryphon says Capek knows how to cure the Plague.
zh: 帕克，格里芬说卡佩克知道怎么治愈瘟疫。

en: I'm coming up there to help you.
zh: 我这就上去帮你。

en: Parker, I have an idea where Capek is headed.
zh: 帕克，我大概知道卡佩克要去哪了。

en: For years, there've been rumors of some sort of secret facility deep underground.
zh: 多年来，一直有传闻说地下深处有某种秘密设施。

en: It's not in the main Ultor security network, so I don't know what's there.
zh: 它不在乌尔托主安保网络里，所以我不知道那里有什么。

en: I'm going to try to hack into the facility's systems from here.
zh: 我准备从这里试着黑进那座设施的系统。

en: Ah, Parker. So you made it past my little guards.
zh: 啊，帕克，看来你闯过了我的那些小警卫。

en: Welcome to my zoo, Parker. Feel free to pet the animals. They won't bite.
zh: 欢迎来到我的动物园，帕克。摸摸动物吧。它们不咬人。

en: OK, Parker, this is the training phase of your Red Faction probationary period.
zh: 好了，帕克，这是你加入红色派系试用期的训练阶段。

en: If you survive, you'll be ready to help lead the miner rebellion against Ultor, when the time comes.
zh: 如果你能活下来，等到时机成熟，你就能协助领导反抗乌尔托的矿工起义。”

en: Some doors open as you approach.
zh: 有些门会在你靠近时打开。

en: Others, like this airlock door, require you to press a button to open.
zh: 其他门，比如这扇气闸门，需要你按下按钮才会打开。

en: Press Use ($USE$) to activate the button and open the doors to the airlock.
zh: 按使用键($USE$)启动按钮，打开通往气闸的门。

en: If the button doesn't work, the door's locked. You'll have to find the access card or control to unlock it.
zh: 如果按钮没反应，说明门锁住了，你得找到门禁卡或控制装置来解锁。

en: Keep an eye on your suit's gauges, which are in the upper left corner of your HUD. The outer ring is your suit's integrity. If it gets to zero, you suffer damage when you're outside.
zh: 注意环境服的仪表，它们在HUD左上角。外环是环境服完整度，如果降到零，你在外面时就会受到伤害。

en: The inner ring is your health. When it gets to zero, you're dead.
zh: 内环是你的生命值，降到零，你就死了。

en: Practice climbing on the fence, girders, and ladder in your envirosuit.
zh: 穿着环境服，在栅栏、横梁和梯子上练习攀爬。

en: When you're done, climb up the ladder and go through the door.
zh: 练完后，爬上梯子，穿过那扇门。

en: Get used to that sound. You'll hear alarms a lot once we strike back at Ultor.
zh: 习惯那个声音吧。等我们反击乌尔托后，你会经常听到警报。

en: Step into the security control room to learn how to use a monitor.
zh: 走进安保控制室，学习如何使用监视器。

en: Go up to a monitor and press Use ($USE$).
zh: 走到监视器前，按使用键($USE$)。

en: Monitors let you see through security cameras in other locations. So we can turn Ultor's surveillance systems against them.
zh: 监视器能让你看到其他地点的安保摄像头画面，这样我们就能反过来利用乌尔托的监视系统。

en: Pretend the barrels are guards and take them out with this turret.
zh: 把那些桶当成警卫，用这座炮塔干掉它们。

en: Walk up to the turret and press Use ($USE$) to control the turret. Press Fire ($FIRE$) to shoot.
zh: 走到炮塔前，按使用键($USE$)控制炮塔，按开火键($FIRE$)射击。

en: If you've been injured or your suit's been damaged, check containers, medical cabinets, and lockers for medpacks and suit repair kits.
zh: 如果你受伤了，或者环境服受损，就检查容器、医药柜和储物柜，找医疗包和环境服维修包。

en: Go up to a container and press Use ($USE$) to open it.
zh: 走到容器前，按使用键($USE$)打开。

en: If you ever need to hide a body, pick it up, carry it somewhere out of the way, and dump it.
zh: 如果你需要藏尸体，就把它捡起来，搬到不碍事的地方，再扔下。

en: To pick up a body, get close and press Use ($USE$).
zh: 要捡起尸体，靠近后按使用键($USE$)。

en: To drop a body, find an open space and press Use ($USE$) again.
zh: 要放下尸体，找个空地，再按一次使用键($USE$)。

en: There's a medic in the room to your right. Medics are sworn to heal anyone, even rebels.
zh: 你右边的房间里有个医疗兵。医疗兵发誓会治疗任何人，哪怕是反抗者。

en: Go to the medic and he'll bandage your wounds.
zh: 去找医疗兵，他会给你包扎伤口。

en: Nothing more to shoot here, Parker. Keep moving.
zh: 这里没东西可打了，帕克，继续前进。

en: Press Jump ($JUMP$) or Crouch ($CROUCH$) to climb up or down. You can also move forward while looking up or down.
zh: 按跳跃键($JUMP$)或蹲伏键($CROUCH$)向上或向下攀爬，你也可以在抬头或低头时向前移动。

en: Looks like this door is broken. Crouch to get underneath it.
zh: 看来这扇门坏了，蹲下从下面过去。

en: Press Crouch ($CROUCH$) to crawl beneath obstacles that are too low to walk under standing up.
zh: 按蹲伏键($CROUCH$)，从低到无法站着通过的障碍物下面爬过去。

en: Practice jumping across this small gap.
zh: 练习跳过这个小缺口。

en: Press Jump ($JUMP$) to leap across the pool of water.
zh: 按跳跃键($JUMP$)跳过水池。

en: This gap is wider. Get a running start and don't jump until you're right at the edge.
zh: 这个缺口更宽。先助跑，直到边缘再跳。

en: Walk up to the medic and press Use ($USE$) to have him bandage you.
zh: 走到医疗兵前，按使用键($USE$)，让他给你包扎。

en: Hey! If you destroy the cameras, I can't see you and I'll have a hard time helping you through training.
zh: 嘿！你把摄像头打坏了，我就看不到你了，也就很难帮你完成训练。

en: You need to learn how to use security monitors before progressing to the next training stage.
zh: 进入下一训练阶段前，你得先学会使用安保监视器。

en: You have to destroy all the barrels to advance to the next section of training.
zh: 你必须摧毁所有桶，才能进入下一段训练。

en: You need to let the medic heal you before moving on to the next section of training.
zh: 继续下一段训练前，你得先让医疗兵给你治疗。

en: You must dump the body in the storage room before you can advance to the next training stage.
zh: 你必须把尸体扔进储藏室，才能进入下一训练阶段。

en: You need to open some of the containers before you can progress to the next section of training.
zh: 继续下一段训练前，你得先打开几个容器。

en: If those barrels were guards, you'd be dead. Move along to the next area.
zh: 如果那些桶是警卫，你已经死了。去下一个区域吧。

en: Ask nicely, and the miner will open the door for you.
zh: 好好开口，那个矿工会替你开门。

en: Press Use ($USE$) to interact with people.
zh: 按使用键($USE$)与人互动。

en: Go right on through, Parker.
zh: 直接过去吧，帕克。

en: Like the sub? We stole it from Ultor.
zh: 喜欢这艘潜艇吗？我们从乌尔托那儿偷来的。

en: Climb in and take it for a ride, in case you have to drive a vehicle after we launch the revolt.
zh: 进去开一圈，免得我们发动起义后，你却不会开载具。

en: Go over to the sub and press Use ($USE$) to enter.
zh: 走到潜艇旁，按使用键($USE$)进入。

en: Fire some torpedoes to get a feel for it.
zh: 发射几枚鱼雷，熟悉一下手感。

en: Head for the other tunnel when you're ready to continue.
zh: 准备好继续时，就去另一条隧道。

en: Climb out of the sub and go up the stairs.
zh: 从潜艇里出来，上楼梯。

en: Press Use ($USE$) to exit the sub.
zh: 按使用键($USE$)离开潜艇。

en: Open the gun cabinet and grab the pistol and sniper rifle.
zh: 打开枪柜，拿上手枪和狙击步枪。

en: Sometimes it pays to be inconspicuous. Holstering your weapon will help you blend in, since guns make people jumpy.
zh: 有时候不起眼反而有好处。收起武器会让你更容易混进去，因为枪会让人紧张。

en: Press the Holster ($HOLSTER$) button to holster and unholster your weapon.
zh: 按收枪键($HOLSTER$)收起或拔出武器。

en: Take some target practice here. Be sure to destroy all the bottles.
zh: 在这里练习打靶，记得把所有瓶子都打碎。

en: Press the Fire ($FIRE$) button to fire.
zh: 按开火键($FIRE$)开火。

en: Press the Alt Fire ($ALT_FIRE$) button to zoom in with the sniper rifle or attach the silencer to the pistol.
zh: 按副开火键($ALT_FIRE$)用狙击步枪缩放瞄准，或给手枪装上消音器。

en: Open up your message log and scroll through the messages I've sent you.
zh: 打开你的消息记录，翻看我发给你的消息。

en: Press the Message Log ($MESSAGE_LOG$) button to open or close the message log.
zh: 按消息记录键($MESSAGE_LOG$)打开或关闭消息记录。

en: Use the directional button or left analog stick to scroll through the messages.
zh: 用方向键或左模拟摇杆滚动查看消息。

en: This log automatically records messages that you receive.
zh: 这份记录会自动保存你收到的消息。

en: Reinforced glass is unbreakable. Go ahead -- shoot it.
zh: 强化玻璃打不碎。来吧 —— 开枪试试。

en: Normal glass can be shattered by weapon fire, allowing you into the room beyond.
zh: 普通玻璃可以被武器打碎，让你进入后面的房间。

en: The containers inside the room hold a rocket launcher and some remote charges.
zh: 房间里的容器里有火箭发射器和一些遥控炸药。

en: Use these to blow a hole in the wall at the 'X.'
zh: 用这些在标着“X”的墙上炸出一个洞。

en: Press the Next Weapon ($NEXT_WEAPON$) and Previous Weapon buttons ($PREV_WEAPON$) to cycle through your available weapons.
zh: 按下一件武器键($NEXT_WEAPON$)和上一件武器键($PREV_WEAPON$)，在可用武器之间切换。

en: Once the hole's big enough, go through it. Then get onto the elevator back to the mines.
zh: 洞够大以后，就从里面过去，然后上电梯回矿区。

en: Congratulations, you've passed the Red Faction training session!
zh: 恭喜，你通过了红色派系训练课程！

en: Activate the elevator to exit the training area.
zh: 启动电梯，离开训练区。

en: Nothing more to shoot here, Parker. Keep moving.
zh: 这里没东西可打了，帕克，继续前进。

en: This door's locked. You'll have to find another way around.
zh: 这扇门锁住了，你得找别的路绕过去。

en: The gauge in the upper right of your HUD shows how much ammo you have left.
zh: HUD右上角的仪表显示你还剩多少弹药。

en: The first number shows the rounds in your weapon. The second shows the extra rounds you're carrying.
zh: 第一个数字显示当前武器内的弹药，第二个数字显示你携带的备用弹药。

en: Go through the door on your left to enter the target range.
zh: 穿过左边的门，进入靶场。

en: Press the Fire ($FIRE$) button to select the highlighted weapon. Press the Alt Fire ($ALT_FIRE$) button to exit without selecting a weapon.
zh: 按开火键($FIRE$)选择高亮武器，按副开火键($ALT_FIRE$)不选武器并退出。

en: Press the Fine Aim ($FINE_AIM$) button for more precise aiming. This is helpful when you use scoped weapons.
zh: 按精确瞄准键($FINE_AIM$)进行更精确的瞄准，使用带瞄准镜的武器时很有用。

en: Press the Reload ($RELOAD$) button to put a fresh magazine in your current weapon.
zh: 按装填键($RELOAD$)，给当前武器换上新弹匣。

en: Explosive weapons damage only softer materials, such as concrete, cement, or rock, not harder materials, such as metal or steel.
zh: 爆炸武器只能破坏较软的材料，比如混凝土、水泥或岩石，不能破坏较硬的材料，比如金属或钢铁。

en: You must ask the miner to open the door before moving on to the next stage of training.
zh: 进入下一训练阶段前，你必须请矿工打开门。

en: You have to shoot all the bottles before advancing to the next section of training.
zh: 进入下一段训练前，你必须射碎所有瓶子。

en: You must take the weapons from the cabinet before progressing on to the next training stage.
zh: 继续下一训练阶段前，你必须从柜子里拿走武器。

en: OK, Parker -- time to go. Get back to the barracks before you're missed.
zh: 好了，帕克 —— 该走了。趁没人发现，回兵营去。
